model.name: Mizuno Wave Rider 29 - Men's
model.description:
Embrace the feeling of effortless stride with the Mizuno Wave Rider 29. Perfect for your next marathon, these versatile shoes feature the Mizuno Wave plate, which disperses energy from impact into a broader area to provide stability and cushioning. Designed to maximize energy return, these shoes enhance your efficiency and keep you moving with the next generation of Mizuno Enerzy midsole material. The legendary MIZUNO WAVE structure delivers a ride that feels both familiar and revolutionary, while eco-friendly recycled materials prove that peak performance and planet-friendly choices can stride side by side. Durable and supportive, the Mizuno Wave Rider 29 makes sure you’re always ready to go the extra mile.

Mizuno Wave Rider 29 features:

  • Jacquard mesh upper provides breathability.
  • Innovative gusseted tongue hugs the foot securely and comfortably.
  • Strategic placement of carbon rubber maximizes durability in high-wear areas and enhances responsiveness.
  • X10 outsole with carbon rubber delivers durability.
  • Heel-to-toe drop: 10 mm.
  • Weight: 8 oz.

sizeChart.sizeChartTipTx:
Unfortunately, there is no international sizing standard. Sizes vary from country to country. Please use the tables above only as a guide to help you in ordering the correct size. Please note that all sizes, are listed and sold in US sizes., |

Women's shoes are made on a narrower last (the foot-shaped form used in making shoes) than men's. In addition, the heel on a woman's shoe is narrower than the forefoot width. Men's shoes have the same width at the forefoot and heel. The medium width for women's shoes is B, while the medium width for men's shoes is D.

Women can wear men's shoes by converting their size to men's by subtracting 1.5 from their numeric size. For example, if you are a size 8 in women's, you would try a 6.5 in men's sizes. This is a loose conversion and doesn't change the difference in width and forefoot-to-heel ratios.

, | If you still have questions about fit or sizing please contact Customer Service., | If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the smaller size for a tighter fit or the larger size for a looser fit.
